text: I keep coming across mathematics projects that bring knot theory to bear on physical field equations - studying how knots show up in the solution fields themselves, whether as knotted electromagnetic or magnetic field lines, knotted vortex lines and tubes in ideal fluid flows, or knotted nodal lines of quantum wavefunctions satisfying Maxwell's, Euler's or Schrodinger's equations. How do the projects working in this area differ in the physical systems and equations they focus on?
reference_answer: KNOTDYNAPP takes an electromagnetic and quantum-mechanical route: it proves that every knot type can occur as a stable closed field line of an electromagnetic field satisfying Maxwell's equations, constructs optical and quantum vortex knots as the knotted zeros of wavefunctions obeying Schrodinger and paraxial equations, and ties a knot's fiberedness to whether the magnetic field induced by a current through a knotted wire vanishes anywhere. GEOFLUIDS works instead in fluid mechanics and spectral theory, proving the Arnold-Moffatt conjecture on knotted vortex lines and Kelvin's conjecture on thin vortex tubes in Beltrami and steady Euler flows, and answering Berry's 2001 question by building Laplacian eigenfunctions whose nodal sets realize any knot type. FLUSPEC, a companion geometric-PDE program, targets smooth stationary solutions of the 3D Euler equations with chaotic trajectories confined in knotted vortex tubes of any topology, and studies vortex reconnection in the Gross-Pitaevskii equation. All three apply knot theory to solutions of physical field equations, but KNOTDYNAPP centres on electromagnetic field lines and quantum vortex knots whereas GEOFLUIDS and FLUSPEC centre on knotted vortex structures in incompressible fluid flows.
notes: Seeds: candidate cp2 vector-09 proposed KNOTDYNAPP(101023017)+BOPNIE(682537) via euroscivoc 'knot theory'. Reading BOPNIE(682537) shows it studies boundary value problems for nonlinear integrable PDEs; 'knot theory' appears once in a passing list of fields where integrable equations arise, and no knotted structure is studied - REJECTED as a euroscivoc false positive. KNOTDYNAPP is a genuine seed. Completeness sweep (non-embedding): run_sql objective LIKE '%knot%' returned the full 31-row universe; the only genuine knot-in-physical-field projects are KNOTDYNAPP(101023017), GEOFLUIDS(633152), FLUSPEC(862342); abstract-topology neighbours QuantGeomLangTFT(637618, TQFT knot invariants), LDTSing(101030083, algebraic/torus knots in 4-manifold surgery), MM-CAHF(893282, Heegaard Floer knot invariants), REFINV, OXTOP, GENERALIZED, ROGW all OUT (knots studied abstractly, no physical field); GOKNOT(796969, protein-backbone gordian knot via molecular dynamics) and MaCChines(787115, protein origami) OUT (discrete polymer, not a field-equation solution); euroscivoc 'knot theory' = {KNOTDYNAPP, BOPNIE}. Pooled adjudication (k=20, 37 candidates): IN KNOTDYNAPP (ranks L1/D1/H1/R1; EM field-line knots, quantum/optical vortex knots, fibered-knot vs induced magnetic field); IN GEOFLUIDS (L4/D2/H3/R2; knotted vortex lines/tubes in Beltrami/Euler flows, knotted nodal sets in QM); IN FLUSPEC (L2/D3/H2/R4; knotted vortex tubes of any topology in Euler flows, Gross-Pitaevskii vortex reconnection). OUT boundary candidates read in full: BOPNIE(682537) integrable-PDE BVPs; VORTSHEET(706283) 2D vortex sheets/patches, no knots; IPFLOW(725967) geodesic/Anosov flows and CFT, no knots; 3DWATERWAVES(678698) water waves over Beltrami flows, no knotted structures; HADE(669689) single vortex-filament equation/Talbot effect, no knot topology; GRAPHCPX(678156) graph-complex TQFT / rational homotopy of knot-spaces, abstract; TopMechMat(771503) 'knot' metaphorical (band-structure braiding); MM-CAHF(893282) abstract knot invariants. Remaining 34-3 rejected pooled candidates are integrable-systems / QFT / geometry projects with no knot topic (absent from the objective-'knot' universe). term_style=exact-term: all three gold retrieved by lexical (KNOTDYNAPP L1, FLUSPEC L2, GEOFLUIDS L4), confirming real term overlap with the question's borrowed vocabulary (knot theory, field lines, vortex tubes, nodal, Maxwell/Euler/Schrodinger). Level computed: |gold|=3 in [2,4] => L2. GEOFLUIDS and FLUSPEC are companion grants of the same fluid-knot program; both genuinely satisfy so both are kept, and the reference notes their kinship.

text: Which projects study microplastic pollution or toxin-producing cyanobacterial and algal blooms in freshwater ecosystems such as lakes and rivers?
reference_answer: This is a sizable freshwater landscape splitting into two strands. Microplastic pollution in freshwaters: FreshwaterMPs (environmental fate and ecotoxicity of microplastics in freshwater habitats), LimnoPlast (sources-to-solutions for microplastics across Europe's freshwaters), MICROPATH (fate and persistence of microplastics, and their role as pathogen vectors, in lowland rivers) and PLANET (how plastic pollution alters the biogeochemical cycling of elements in freshwaters). Toxin-producing cyanobacterial and algal blooms in lakes, rivers and reservoirs: MicroEcoEvol (ecology and evolution of toxic Microcystis blooms in eutrophic lakes), the Earth-observation and forecasting services CyanoAlert, WQeMS and INNO-CYANO (detecting and forecasting harmful cyanobacterial blooms and lake water quality), NaToxAq (occurrence, fate and removal of cyanotoxins and other natural toxins in water bodies supplying drinking water) and TOXICROP (surveillance and control of toxic cyanobacterial blooms and cyanotoxins in eutrophic freshwaters). Together they map a freshwater landscape spanning plastic pollution and harmful cyanobacterial/algal blooms.
notes: Requested cell vector/L3/survey/exact-term. RECTIFICATION of reviewer FATAL F1 (incomplete/inconsistent key). Route (b) chosen: narrowed the question to the two illustrative strands so the key is bounded and the IN rule is consistently applicable; a new wording was set, so pooled retrieval was re-run on it. Crisp IN rule: project's substantive subject is EITHER (i) microplastic/plastic pollution, OR (ii) toxin-producing cyanobacterial/algal (harmful) blooms and their cyanotoxins, studied/monitored/surveilled in an actual freshwater body (lake/river/stream/reservoir). This deliberately excludes the entire micropollutant/pharmaceutical/azole/nanoparticle strand, resolving the F1 inconsistency: LakeMP, NanoToX and the reviewer's HypoTRAIN (641939), EXPOZOL (744052), TRANSFORMER (657425) are all now consistently OUT (micropollutants/pharmaceuticals/antifungal-azoles/nanoparticles - neither microplastics nor blooms). Gold: microplastics strand = 660306 FreshwaterMPs, 833702 MICROPATH, 860720 LimnoPlast, 101023603 PLANET (report confirms freshwater focus); bloom/cyanotoxin strand = 656647 MicroEcoEvol, 730141 CyanoAlert, 101004157 WQeMS, 739763 INNO-CYANO, 722493 NaToxAq, 823860 TOXICROP. sEEIngDOM (804673) DROPPED per F1 NOTE (its microplastic tie is one incidental sampling sentence; its subject is DOM chemodiversity/carbon cycling) - resolves the unbounded-scope symptom. Pooled k=20 all four conditions on the final wording -> 36 distinct projects. IN (9 of the 36, + NaToxAq from sweep): 656647 MicroEcoEvol (L1/D5/H1/R1), 860720 LimnoPlast (L7/D1/H2/R4), 660306 FreshwaterMPs (L11/D2/H3/R3), 823860 TOXICROP (L2/D9/H4/R5; report: monitoring of toxic cyanobacteria/cyanotoxins in reservoirs and water bodies), 833702 MICROPATH (D3/H6/R2), 739763 INNO-CYANO (L4/D20/H7/R14), 101004157 WQeMS (L9), 101023603 PLANET (H17/R11), 730141 CyanoAlert (L16/H12/R12). Full-landscape completeness sweep (mandated), over objective AND report_text (teaser+summary+workPerformed+finalResults), each strand restricted to freshwater terms (freshwater/lake/river/stream/reservoir/pond/limno): (a) microplastics terms (microplastic/nanoplastic/plastic pollution/plastic litter/plastic debris) = 69 hits; only FreshwaterMPs/LimnoPlast/MICROPATH/PLANET meet the IN rule; all other hits OUT - marine (ASTRAL, ATLANTIS, AtlantECO, CLAIM, In-No-Plastic, LABPLAS, ODYSSEA, POSEIDOMM, PLOCEAN, Nexus, SEA2LAND, EnviroCaps), riverine-litter-to-marine (846843 LitRivus - marine-litter science, rivers as flux pathway to the ocean, MSFD endpoint), soil (SOPLAS, PlastiSol), bioplastics/packaging/textile/biodegradation (BioICEP, BlockPLA, EcoFLEXY, ENZYCLE, FRAMTID, GLOPACK, Glaukos, HEREWEAR, New Cotton, P4SB, RECOVER, SULACHANGE, SOLIMER, Ligninpolymers, LigniOx, RePLAy, EUROqCHARM), removal/cleanup tech (MICROPLASTINE, MinusMicro, Great Bubble Barrier, MULTISOURCE, SOCRATIC), health/other (DermPlast, NanoPhosTox, LeDNA, ECORISK2050, Gradual_Change, RAVE, SARCOM, NEMO, STIMULATOR, SUSINCHAIN, NoAW, CEBREWA, LASERLAB). text: Among glaciology projects that started in 2021 or later, what past climatic change does the project that trains a new generation of early-stage researchers around the deep Antarctic ice core drilled by the Beyond EPICA campaign aim to help explain?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM project p JOIN euroscivoc e ON e.projectID = p.id WHERE e.euroSciVocPath LIKE '%/glaciology%' AND p.startDate >= DATE '2021-01-01'

reference_answer: The project is DEEPICE (grant 955750), a research and training network for 15 early-stage researchers (ESRs) built around the 1.5-million-year-old Antarctic ice core being recovered by the Beyond EPICA drilling campaign. It aims to help explain the Mid-Pleistocene Transition (MPT) - the change, between about 900,000 and 1.2 million years ago, when the cyclicity of glacial/interglacial cycles shifted from 40,000 to 100,000 years - including the role of ice-sheet size and atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations in past climate dynamics.
notes: FILTER RATIONALE: euroSciVocPath LIKE '%/glaciology%' (subtree match, no leading slash per schema value note) AND startDate >= 2021-01-01. Executed this pass: 43 glaciology projects total, 7 survive the date filter. Survivors read in full (S<=20, exhaustive). PER-SURVIVOR ADJUDICATION on the identifier 'training network for early-stage researchers built around the Beyond EPICA deep Antarctic ice core': 955750 DEEPICE IN - only survivor that is a research and training network (15 ESRs, 10 countries) explicitly built around the 'Beyond EPICA' ice drilling to extract a 1.5-million-year Antarctic ice core; 889508 SCADI OUT - single-fellow MSCA-IF on a nitrogen-isotope snow-accumulation proxy; uses EPICA Dome C data but is not a training network and not built around the Beyond EPICA drilling; 885891 IceAq OUT - individual fellowship on proglacial/subglacial aquifers in Iceland, no ice core; 101030314 MOTKA OUT - individual fellowship modelling karst-cave temperatures, no ice core; 101027900 MGFR OUT - individual fellowship on Martian glaciations; 101024540 HAIL OUT - individual fellowship on High-Mountain Asia paleoglaciers/monsoon; 101023960 ICEglobe OUT - individual fellowship, scientific/political history of ice sheets, no drilling. |gold|=1. TEXT LOAD-BEARING: the answered fact (that DEEPICE targets the Mid-Pleistocene Transition, with 40,000->100,000-year cyclicity shift) lives only in the free-text objective + report summary; no stored column carries it (title only says 'Infer past antarctiC climatE dynamics'). FILTER LOAD-BEARING: unscoped pooled search on the textual concept returns many projects that satisfy the deep-Antarctic-ice-core / Beyond EPICA / MPT content but FAIL the filter (started before 2021 and/or not glaciology-classified), e.g. 815384 Beyond EPICA (startDate 2019-06-01, 'Beyond EPICA Oldest Ice Core: 1,5 Myr of greenhouse gas - climate feedbacks', dense rank 2 / hybrid 3 / rerank 2), 730258 BE-OI (2016-10-01, 'Beyond EPICA - Oldest Ice', lexical rank 2 / hybrid 2), 817493 ICORDA (2019-12-01, 'Ice CORe DAting... last 1.5 million years'), 790280 GOLD-ICE, 667507 deepSLice, 101023443 CliMoTran ('Comprehensive Climate Modeling of the Mid-Pleistocene Transition'). These out-of-filter projects answer the substantive MPT fact as well as or better than DEEPICE, so without the glaciology+2021 filter the question does not isolate DEEPICE - the filter is doing the work. SQL SWEEP: SELECT over project objective/title ILIKE '%ice core%'/'%EPICA%' with an in_filter flag -> 36 matching projects, only SCADI(889508) and DEEPICE(955750) are in-filter; 34 ice-core projects fail the filter (all started 2015-2022 but are not both glaciology-classified and 2021+). SCOPED RETRIEVABILITY: scoped pooled search over the 7 survivors ranks DEEPICE #1 in all four conditions (lexical/dense/hybrid/hybrid_rerank). TERM_STYLE exact-term: DEEPICE is scoped lexical rank 1, confirming real term overlap ('Beyond EPICA', 'deep ice core', 'Antarctic', 'training network' reused from its title/objective). index_fingerprint be84cbad9182 (n_vectors 190248, bge-base-en-v1.5); schema_docs sd1-pilot c3435815b331; corpus profile cp2.

text: Among the Horizon 2020 projects classified under superconductivity that received EU funding above the 95th percentile of all H2020 projects (about EUR 6.93 million in EC contribution), how do they differ in the application domain they target and in the way they make use of superconductivity?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT p.id, p.acronym, ROUND(p.ecMaxContribution) AS ec FROM project p JOIN euroscivoc e ON e.projectID=p.id WHERE e.euroSciVocPath LIKE '%/superconductivity%' AND p.ecMaxContribution > 6926372.79 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3 DESC

reference_answer: All four are top-funded superconductivity projects but target sharply different domains. EcoSwing delivered the world's first demonstration of a high-temperature superconducting (HTS) direct-drive generator on a 3.6 MW wind turbine, using second-generation (2G) HTS wire coils to cut generator weight and rare-earth reliance in wind power. ARIES is a pan-European accelerator-infrastructure network that develops superconducting magnets, RF cavities with superconducting thin-film coatings, and cryogenics for particle accelerators and high-energy physics. NONLOCAL pursues fundamental quantum physics, engineering topological superconductivity and Majorana bound states in superconductor-semiconductor hybrid devices toward future quantum technologies, while HERO is a condensed-matter physics project searching for new hidden, entangled and resonating orders in correlated-electron quantum matter, where superconductivity figures as one example of the many-body paradigm rather than an engineered device.
notes: FILTER: P95 of project.ecMaxContribution over all 35,389 projects = 6926372.79 (re-executed this session via PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ecMaxContribution)). Superconductivity subtree matched with euroSciVocPath LIKE '%/superconductivity%' (paths carry no leading slash, per schema value note); subtree = 219 distinct projects; above-P95 survivors = exactly 4. TERM_STYLE exact-term: question reuses 'superconductivity/superconductor', distinctive vocabulary present in every gold text; scoped rank matrix shows all four gold found by the lexical condition, confirming real term overlap. PER-SURVIVOR ADJUDICATION (S=4, exhaustive read): 810451 HERO IN - condensed-matter/correlated-electron physics, 'hidden, entangled and resonating orders'; superconductivity cited as a paradigm example of quantum matter. 656024 EcoSwing IN - applied wind-energy domain; HTS direct-drive superconducting generator on a 3.6 MW turbine, 2G HTS wire coils. 730871 ARIES IN - particle-accelerator infrastructure; superconducting magnets, superconducting thin-film RF cavities, HTS tapes, cryogenics. 856526 NONLOCAL IN - fundamental quantum physics; topological superconductivity and Majorana bound states in superconductor-semiconductor hybrids for quantum technologies. All 4 IN => gold = all survivors. FILTER-LOAD-BEARING: unscoped pooled search on the textual theme is dominated by below-threshold superconductivity projects (EASITrain, SUPERTERA, SUPERSPIN, ULTRASUPERTAPE, ASuMED, etc., none in the survivor set); SQL sweep of superconductivity projects at/below P95 names concrete counter-examples that satisfy the textual theme but fail the funding filter: Quaco 689359 (4.65M, superconducting magnets for the LHC - same domain as ARIES), ASuMED 723119 (4.01M, superconducting aircraft propulsion motor), MATQu 101007322 (6.55M, superconducting qubits for quantum computing), AndQC 828948 (3.48M) and TOPSQUAD 862046 (3.18M, topological/Andreev-qubit quantum computing - same domain as NONLOCAL). 215 of the 219 superconductivity projects fall below the threshold, so the funding filter, not the topic, isolates the gold four. TEXT-LOAD-BEARING: application domain and superconductor technology live only in free text; euroSciVocTitle is 'superconductivity' for all four and no stored column encodes wind-generator vs accelerator-magnet vs Majorana vs hidden-order. SCOPED-RETRIEVABLE: scoped pooled top-k ranks EcoSwing/NONLOCAL/ARIES/HERO at 1-4 in lexical, hybrid and hybrid_rerank; HERO absent only from dense. Adjudication is from the exhaustive read; pooled_candidate_count is from the scoped pooled search.
